title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: India Championship Leader
items.text: Niklas Nørgaard leads the DP World India Championship at 6-under after an eagle on No. 1; Rory McIlroy sits three shots back with a 2-under 70 amid lightning delays.

items.headline: Rahm Ends LIV Contract
items.text: Jon Rahm reached a separation agreement with LIV Golf, surrendering the remaining nine-figure money from his $300M deal to regain name/image rights and control of Legion XIII.
